narrative:
The model determined that you have a 53% chance of being a bad credit risk. Because this probability is above the approval threshold, your loan application was denied.

The three factors that most strongly influenced this outcome were the status of your checking account, the amount you requested, and the purpose of the loan. Your checking account is currently in negative balance. Among approved applicants, only 12.6% have a negative balance, while most have either no checking account or a positive one. This situation strongly pushed the prediction toward bad credit risk. The loan amount you asked for, 5,371 DM, is also substantially higher than the average of about 3,020 DM seen among those who were approved. This larger request further increased the model's concern. In contrast, the fact that the loan was for furniture and equipment worked mildly in your favor, as this purpose is relatively common among approved applicants and slightly lowered the risk score.

Taken together, the negative signals from your checking account and the requested amount outweighed the small positive effect of the loan purpose, leading to the denial.

You should focus on building a positive checking account balance, reducing the amount you plan to borrow, and reapplying once these areas improve. This will give you the best chance of approval in the future. (218 words)
